items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I was playing with his father in there at Pest Christian. And I brought him over there and so they, after I had to go up... They stayed up there with me for almost four years.

ctx.x: You're talking about Sam. I mean... Well I'm talking about Yank was playing the trombone with him. Oh yeah.

He was playing trombone. I was the first one to take him over there. And Handy, he was playing the Pest. And so every time I'd go in the Morgan City play I'd come here. I had to go over, of course, to play with his father, Sonny Handy's father. Well alright. I played there several times and I said this fellow here is too good to be over at the Pest. And I take him over here at the Pest. You know Sonny Handy was playing sax. Yeah. They call him Captain. Yeah. And I take him over here and he stayed full ten. I had…
You played carnet in those days I guess. Yeah I was playing carnet.
